# aether_registry_repositories (Data Source)

Every repository in the organization's registry, sorted by name. The list is served live from the registry. A registry that was never enabled answers an error (502); a registry disabled without purge still lists its retained images. `size_bytes` is 0 also when the platform could not compute it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Repositories of the organization's registry, read live from the registry.
data "aether_registry_repositories" "all" {}

output "repositories" {
  value = { for r in data.aether_registry_repositories.all.repositories : r.name => r.artifact_count }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `repositories` (Attributes List) The repositories, sorted by `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `artifact_count` (Number) Number of ARTIFACTS (not tags) in the repository.
- `last_push` (String) Time the repository was last updated (RFC 3339); null when the registry reports none.
- `name` (String) Repository name without the project prefix; it can contain `/` (e.g. `team/app`).
- `size_bytes` (Number) Total size of the repository's artifacts, de-duplicated by digest. 0 also when the platform could not compute it.
